notes.title: Update: added hints and tooltips, optimisation
notes.content:
When you crash you now sometimes get hints such as "attached too late" or "press brake to regain grip", depending on how exactly you crashed.

Also added hover tooltips in the track selection menu to show why a track is unlocked (it was already visible if you selected the track).

Made the bronze time on sand drifts a little easier.

Added an optimisation for tracks with many on-track lights (especially Central Reservation).

notes.title: Update: adjusted a few medal times
notes.content: Weakened a medal time on Spybrake and improved a medal time on Perfect Sunrise, based on some user feedback that they were too difficult/too easy respectively.

notes.title: Update: revamped several early tracks, improved loading speed
notes.content:
Redesigned several of the early tracks to create six new tracks that are faster and more exciting than the ones they replace.  Also improved track loading speed.

Existing players (those playing pre-release in May or earlier) may find that this locks tracks that were previously unlocked.  You'll need to complete the new tracks to unlock the later tracks again.

notes.title: Update: streamlined introduction to game
notes.content: Based on some feedback, removed the first track, streamlined some of the tutorial hints and re-ordered some of the early tracks to give a faster introduction to the game.
